This item was removed in a recent update to the game, the [[Crate factory]] has replaced it. Prior to this update the packing table, which was located in the [[kitchen garden]], was required to craft {{item|crates}} which can be sold at the [[trade office]] in the [[village]]. The blueprint becomes available after obtaining the {{item|trade license}} and completing associated quest with the [[merchant]].

The player can craft {{Quality|silver}} and {{Quality|gold}} quality crates depending on the quality of used vegetables. The boxes can only be sold in the [[trade office]] and have no further use.

An alternative to the usage of the packing table is using the [[crate factory]].
